data.one_liner: OpenStreetMap plugin for Flutter with native Android, iOS, macOS, and Web support.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to embed OpenStreetMap in Flutter applications. It supports current position tracking, marker customization, drawing roads, shapes, address suggestions, and satellite or vector tile presets.
use_when: You need to embed OpenStreetMap inside a Flutter application across mobile, web, and desktop.
You require drawing routes, roads, and custom markers with distance and duration calculations.
avoid_when: You rely exclusively on Google Maps features or proprietary Google navigation APIs.
You need native compass/heading data or native rotation gestures on macOS.
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
Built-in support for vector tiles, satellite views, and custom tile providers.
Provides helper functions for road drawing, address suggestions, and location pickers.
weaknesses: macOS has limited adapter capabilities such as missing heading data and rotation gestures.
Requires specific modern Android SDK/Gradle setups and Xcode versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up platform-specific permissions for location and network access, minimum version requirements (Android compileSdk 37+, iOS 15.6+, macOS 12.0+), and Swift Package Manager for Apple platforms.
